title: Lock-precision and cut-map scoring instrument for frame-sampled stills
purpose: Operationalizes the untested checklist from art_01M6A5NN0JFR92YNZ3YG1V3B85 r1 into two concrete instruments: (1) a scored row template for comparing a seconds-only lock prompt against a seconds+frame-number lock prompt on stills, and (2) a cut-map deviation log for recording direction, head-count and timing misses against a timecoded prompt. Both are fill-in forms; nothing is run here.
